seed_pool_note: training days are drawn from a 5000-block disjoint from the frozen evaluation pool (1-30), so no policy is optimised on a day it is later scored on

obs_scaler.note: constants copied per block from the frozen scaler, so every retained feature is scaled identically to the full-observation arms; nothing was refitted

reward_scales.note: Fitted from the fixed-timetable baseline, per protocol section 6.4.
reward_scales.W_definition: passenger-minutes accrued per epoch (queue integral, amendment A-02)
reward_scales.U_definition: distinct passengers left behind per epoch (amendment A-01)
reward_scales.forecaster_independent: the fixed timetable never reads the observation, so these scales do not depend on which forecaster supplies mu and sigma

hyperparameter_search: NONE. One frozen configuration is applied unchanged to every arm, per the standing constraint in docs/decisions.md. All arms may be jointly suboptimal; the relative comparison is unaffected.
